decision.reasoning_trace: The search results for backpacks were cluttered with unrelated items like sleeping bags and lanterns, which was frustrating. However, in my consideration set, I narrowed it down to five genuine bags. The KAUKKO (184) was a very affordable laptop option, while the Granite Gear (041) was a high-end technical pack. I ultimately chose the Gelindo 18L (078) because it has an exceptionally high rating (4.7) from over 1,500 reviewers, includes a hydration bladder, and is priced reasonably for a daypack.
